basic_details.job_title: THDCIL Recruitment 2026 – Apply Online for 13 Field Engineer, Field Officer Posts
basic_details.post_name: Field Officer (Level I) in discipline of Law, Field Engineer (Level I) in discipline of Safety, Field Engineer (Level-I) in discipline of Structural Engineering and 1 more
basic_details.short_information: THDC India Limited (THDCIL), Across India, has invited applications for 13 posts in 4 roles under Advt No. 09/2026. The posts include Field Officer (Level I) in discipline of Law, Field Engineer (Level I) in discipline of Safety, Field Engineer (Level-I) in discipline of Structural Engineering, Field Engineer (Level-I) in discipline of Geo-Technical Engineering. The online application is open from 25 November 2026 to 24 December 2026.

application_fee.details: Payment mode: Online mode through SBIePay.

qualification.education_qualification: Graduate in Law or Bachelor's Degree in Engineering with M.Tech/Diploma depending on discipline

vacancy_details.details: Qualification required: Graduate with Full time degree in Law with 60% marks from recognised Indian university or 5 year integrated course in Law with 60% marks. Experience required: 01 year of Post Qualification Experience in a Legal department of Central Govt./State Govt./Public sector or a Reputed Private sector organization. Age limit: Maximum 32 years. Pay: Rs 53,580 per month. Qualification required: Bachelor's Degree (B.E/B.Tech/B.Sc Engg.) in Engineering (Four years Full Time course) with not less than 60% marks; 1 year Post Graduate Diploma Full-Time course in Industrial Safety with not less than 60% marks. Experience required: 01 year of Post Qualification Experience in Safety department of Central Govt./State Govt./Public sector or a Reputed Private sector organization. Age limi

exam_pattern.details: No candidate securing overall less than 50% marks in the interview will be empanelled. SC/ST/PwBDs/Ex-Servicemen candidates are required to secure at least 40% marks in the interview.

how_to_apply: Visit the THDCIL website at https://www.thdc.co.in and navigate to Career Section > New Job Opening.
Fill in basic information, academic & professional qualifications, and experience details carefully.
Upload scanned photograph, signature, and required certificates in specified sizes and formats.
Pay the application fee online if applicable (UR/EWS/OBC categories).
Submit the online application form and take a printout of the completed application for future reference.
important_instructions: Computation of age and experience shall be done as on 25.11.2026. Category once filled in online registration form will not be changed. Candidates working in Govt./PSU must produce No Objection Certificate at the time of interview.

Pay: Rs 53,580 per month. content_sections.heading: Pay and Terms of Engagement
content_sections.text: Engaged temporarily for a period of 1 year, extendable on yearly basis for additional 4 years in stages up to a maximum of 5 years. Tenure can be terminated by either party by giving one month notice in writing.

content_sections.heading: Application Fee
content_sections.text: Payment mode: Online mode through SBIePay.

content_sections.heading: How Will THDCIL Select Candidates?
content_sections.text: Shortlisting of candidates for Personal Interview based on percentage of marks in educational qualification and experience weightage Personal Interview Final empanelment based on interview performance and merit Appearance & Physical Agility, Collaboration & Networking: 10 Marks Experience: 10 Marks Communication & Inter Personal Skills, Team & People Leadership: 10 Marks Professional Knowledge & Business Acumen: 30 Marks Aptitude for Project, Change Management & Adaptability, Vision & Strategic orientation, Achievement orientation, System orientation: 40 Marks

content_sections.heading: THDCIL Exam Pattern 2026
content_sections.text: No candidate securing overall less than 50% marks in the interview will be empanelled. SC/ST/PwBDs/Ex-Servicemen candidates are required to secure at least 40% marks in the interview.

content_sections.heading: Documents to Enclose
content_sections.text: Passport size color photograph with white background Scanned signature in black ink Class Xth and XIIth Certificate / Marksheet Essential Qualification Marksheet & Certificate (Master's/Degree) Caste/Category Certificate (if applicable) Proof of CGPA to percentage conversion norms Experience Certificate (if applicable)

content_sections.heading: How to Apply for THDCIL Recruitment 2026 Online
content_sections.text: Visit the THDCIL website at https://www.thdc.co.in and navigate to Career Section > New Job Opening. Fill in basic information, academic & professional qualifications, and experience details carefully. Upload scanned photograph, signature, and required certificates in specified sizes and formats. Pay the application fee online if applicable (UR/EWS/OBC categories). Submit the online application form and take a printout of the completed application for future reference. Apply on or before 24 December 2026.

content_sections.heading: Other Points to Note
content_sections.text: Computation of age and experience shall be done as on 25.11.2026. Category once filled in online registration form will not be changed. Candidates working in Govt./PSU must produce No Objection Certificate at the time of interview.
